entities.name: Millena
entities.description: A young Dimir thoughtstealer whose mind was controlled by Nicol Bolas to infiltrate the Aerie of the Firemind.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who controlled Millena's mind and tore through her memories.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of which Millena was an agent.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The ancient dragon and guildmaster of the Izzet League, into whose mind a thought was implanted.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild that set wards and traps in Nivix.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The Izzet tower whose top holds the Aerie.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: A device meant to lure planeswalkers to Ravnica to feed their sparks to Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Discovered Millena imprisoned on his return to Nivix.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Later tried to extract Millena from Niv-Mizzet.

events.summary: Millena, controlled by Bolas, infiltrates the Aerie at the top of Nivix past the Izzet's wards and traps.
events.quote: Millena's mission from Nicol Bolas was to infiltrate the Aerie at the top of Nivix

events.summary: Millena implants into Niv-Mizzet the thought of building the Interplanar Beacon.
events.quote: Her goal was not to steal but to implant a thought into Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: The presence controlling Millena leads her into a trap, freezing her in a stasis spell to trigger an alarm.
events.quote: left her frozen in place by a stasis spell, effectively sacrificing her to trigger an alarm

events.summary: Nicol Bolas tears through Millena's memories, leaving her mind in shambles.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas tore through her memories, leaving her mind in shambles

events.summary: Ral Zarek discovers Millena imprisoned and learns from Niv-Mizzet that she was a pawn.
events.quote: discovered her imprisoned and learned from Niv-Mizzet that she was a pawn

events.summary: Lazav tries to extract Millena from Niv-Mizzet's claws; her fate is unknown.
events.quote: Lazav later made efforts to extract Millena from Niv-Mizzet's claws

relations.quote: a thought-stealer agent of House Dimir
reducing her to a puppet carrying out his plans
the ancient dragon and guildmaster of the Izzet League
